title: Paralia
meta_description: Find the perfect Seagrove Beach, FL vacation rental at ‘Paralia’ a Luxury 4 Bedroom, 4.5 Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 16 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Lake Front, Elevator & Golf Cart for your enjoyment.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • 4 Bedrooms • 4.5 Full Baths • Brand New Construction • Golf Cart & Bikes Included • SQFT: 3844 • Stories: 2 • Lake Front • Heated Private Pool & Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $30 per day from October 1 - May 1) • Sleeps 12 • Parking for 5 Cars DESCRIPTION: Welcome to ‘Paralia’, a new construction breathtaking coastal retreat designed to accommodate up to 12 guests, offering the ultimate blend of refined luxury and laid-back beachside charm. Nestled beside the serene Tresca Lake, this exquisite home invites you to experience the perfect balance of tranquility and sophistication. The thoughtfully designed sleeping arrangements ensure comfort and privacy for all. The first floor features a primary bedroom with a king bed and an ensuite bathroom complete with a double vanity and an elegant soaking tub enclosed in an expansive tile and glass shower. On the second floor, the sleeping quarters expand to include a second primary bedroom with a king bed with an ensuite bathroom offering a double vanity and a soaking tub enclosed in a inviting tile and glass shower, plus access to a private balcony showcasing serene lake views Two additional guest bedrooms on this floor each feature king beds both have ensuite bathrooms, one with a single vanity and a tile and glass shower, the other with a shower and tub combo. For the younger generations, a cozy bunk nook with two twin-over-twin bunk beds provides sleeping accommodations for four. Indoors, every detail has been meticulously curated to ensure both comfort and elegance, with 10-foot ceilings, custom cabinetry, rich hardwood flooring, and a chef-inspired kitchen featuring Thermador appliances. Dual primary suites, luxurious bathrooms, and versatile sleeping arrangements make ‘Paralia’ an ideal destination for large families or groups of friends. Outdoor living spaces elevate the experience further, with upper and lower decks overlooking Tresca Lake, a raised spa and heated saltwater pool, and a fully equipped summer kitchen with a TV wall. These areas are perfect for alfresco dining, entertaining, or simply unwinding under the sun or stars. Located within The Cove at Tresca Lake, a boutique community of just five exclusive homes, ‘Paralia’ sits perfectly between Tresca Lake, Eastern Lake, and the Gulf of Mexico. High-end finishes such as shiplap walls and vaulted wood-accent ceilings enhance the warm yet sophisticated ambiance of this coastal retreat. ‘Paralia’ is more than a home; it’s your private oasis on the coveted 30A coastline, where relaxation and luxury meet in perfect harmony SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 12) FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 2) • Bedroom 1: Primary Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & Ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanity with Elegant Soaking Tub Enclosed in Expansive Tile/Glass Shower SECOND FLOOR: (Sleeps 10) • Bedroom 2: Primary Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & Ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanity with Elegant Soaking Tub Enclosed in Expansive Tile/Glass Shower + Private Balcony with Coastal Dune Lake Views • Bedroom 3: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & Ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Tile/Glass Shower • Bedroom 4: Guest Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & Ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity with Shower/Tub Combo • Bunk Nook: Two Twin Over Twin Bunk Beds (sleeps 4) LAYOUT: FIRST FLOOR • Main Living Area with Lake Views • Seating Area • Living Room with Gas Fireplace • Dining Room – Table Seats 10 • Culinary Kitchen with Upscale Appliances • Large Kitchen Island Seats 4 • Wet Bar with Wine Fridge and Ice Machine • Laundry Room with Sink • Mud Room • Primary Bedroom SECOND FLOOR • Primary Bedroom • King Guest Suite • King Guest Suite • Bunk Nook OUTDOOR LIVING • Private Heated Pool & Spa • Grilling Station • Outdoor Dining (Table Seats 6)
